name: DC-003 - Content Request Workflow (Mock, Manual Trigger)
description: DC-003-I017: manual-trigger n8n workflow invoking I016's Content Request Command CLI unchanged (mock production path) against the repo at /data/dc003-repo, persisting via I015 to /home/node/.n8n/dc003/finished-carousels. Does not modify or replace the I013 workflow.

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ { command: "Create 6 designs based on article GS01" } }}

parameters.command:
=RUN_DIR=/tmp/dc003-i017-run-{{ $now.toFormat('yyyyLLdd-HHmmssSSS') }}
mkdir -p "$RUN_DIR"
cat > "$RUN_DIR/command.txt" << 'COMMAND_EOF'
{{ $json.command }}
COMMAND_EOF
STORE_DIR=/home/node/.n8n/dc003/finished-carousels
mkdir -p "$STORE_DIR"
cd /data/dc003-repo
COMMAND_TEXT=$(cat "$RUN_DIR/command.txt")
node tests/validation/content-request.mjs "$COMMAND_TEXT" "$STORE_DIR" --json > "$RUN_DIR/output.json" 2> "$RUN_DIR/run.log" || true
cat "$RUN_DIR/output.json"

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ { success: $json.success, status: $json.status, requestId: $json.requestId, sourceReference: $json.sourceReference, executionId: $json.executionId, carouselId: $json.carouselId, stored: $json.stored, storeReference: $json.storeReference, warnings: $json.warnings, message: "Six-design carousel generated and stored successfully." } }}
={{ { success: $json.success, status: $json.status, requestId: $json.requestId, sourceReference: $json.sourceReference, error: $json.error, warnings: $json.warnings } }}

parameters.content:
## DC-003-I017 - Content Request Workflow (Mock)

Manual Trigger -> Build Content Request -> Run I016 Content Request Command -> Parse Content Request Result -> Success? -> Prepare Success/Failure Output.

Invokes DC-003-I016's CLI unchanged (npm run content:request, run as `node tests/validation/content-request.mjs "<command>" <storeDirectory> --json`) against the repo read-only bind-mounted at /data/dc003-repo. No parsing, source resolution, generation, rendering, or persistence logic is duplicated here - I016 owns all of it.

Persistent storage: /home/node/.n8n/dc003/finished-carousels (inside the durable n8n_data volume, survives container recreation, outside the read-only repo mount, never committed to Git).

Mock rendering only - no live Templated calls, no credentials. GS01 resolves only against an approved fixture Topic Package (tests/fixtures/topic-packages/backlog-gs01.approved.json) - not a real article source yet. See DC-003 README "Content Request Command - current limitations".
